note.text:
A platform dashboard that only glows on conversion is a trap carried over from linear product thinking.

Interaction - transactions, clicks, time on app - is the easiest thing to optimize and the easiest thing to mistake for health. But interaction is downstream of two quieter jobs: bringing both sides onto the platform (accumulation) and helping them actually find each other (connection).

Optimize interaction alone and the shape of the ecosystem goes lopsided - strong engagement, weak pipeline, poor matching. It looks fine until producer growth stalls, and then the whole thing stalls with it.

Every feature, every metric, every backlog item should get tagged to one of the three - accumulation, connection, or interaction - and all three should move together on the same report, not one in isolation.

A platform grows only as fast as its weakest axis.
